a workshop and presentation slide.
EK W
For the last portion of today's data management workshop,
we'll be reviewing various ways of presenting data with our
new software program. As you can see on this slide, there
are different options for converting numbers into graphic
form. Now, you all brought some company sales data from
the last quarter. I'd like everyone to practice creating a line
graph with this data. That graph is best for showing how
sales have risen and fallen over the quarter. So, thanks
for bringing your laptops with you. Go ahead and turn your
laptops on now, and we'll get started.
Pie Chart
Bar Graph
Line Graph
Cycle Chart
